title: Introducing SVGSpace: The Free Open-Source SVG Hosting Platform
excerpt: 6,500+ free brand SVG icons with multi-variant support, live preview pages, NPM package distribution, and global CDN delivery. Upload, host, and publish your icons on SVGSpace.
author: Orildo Engineering Team
body: Today we are launching **SVGSpace (svgspace.sbs)**, a free, open-source SVG hosting, publishing, and distribution platform. Upload individual icons or complete multi-variant icon packs. Our 7-minute ingestion pipeline validates, optimizes, packages, and hosts them with live shareable preview pages, NPM package distribution, global CDN delivery, and ready-to-use code for React, Vue, Svelte, and more. ## What makes SVGSpace different Unlike traditional icon libraries that require you to download and integrate static assets, SVGSpace is a **hosting platform**. Every icon gets: - **Dedicated live shareable page** with preview and code snippets - **NPM package installation** via `npx @orildo/icons add ` - **Global CDN endpoints** for direct embedding - **Multi-variant support**: default, mono, dark, light, wordmark - **Instant code export**: React JSX, React Native, Next.js, Vue 3, Svelte, Angular, HTML - **High-resolution export**: PNG, WebP, JPG, ICO, Data URI ## The catalog We're launching with **6,500+ curated brand logos and developer tool icons** across 50+ categories: - **Software & Developer Tools**: React, Vue, Node.js, Python, TypeScript, Docker, Kubernetes - **Cloud Providers**: AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform with complete service icon sets - **AI & Machine Learning**: OpenAI, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face - **Frameworks & Libraries**: Next.js, Svelte, Angular, Laravel, Django - **Liquid Glass**: Premium translucent frosted-glass style vectors for 160+ brands - **Regional Brands**: Pakistani brands and international tech companies ## How it works ### 1. Upload Your Icons Navigate to the Publish page, provide your icon details: - **Slug**: Unique identifier (e.g., `stripe`, `aws-lambda`) - **Title**: Brand name (e.g., "Stripe", "AWS Lambda") - **Categories**: Software, AI, Cloud, etc. - **Brand Colors**: Primary hex code and color palette - **Variants**: Upload SVG files for default, mono, dark, light, wordmark ### 2. 7-Minute Ingestion Pipeline Our processing engine automatically: - Validates XML structure and viewBoxes - Optimizes vector paths for subpixel rendering - Detects and extracts brand color swatches - Creates permanent live preview pages - Generates CDN endpoints and code snippets - Packages for NPM distribution ### 3. Share and Integrate - **Live preview page**: `https://svgspace.sbs/icon/` - **NPM install**: `npx @orildo/icons add ` - **CDN embed**: `https://cdn.svgspace.sbs/icons//default.svg` - **Framework code**: Copy React JSX, Vue, Svelte components with one click ## For developers ### React/Next.js ```jsx import { StripeIcon } from '@orildo/react'; ``` ### Vue 3 ```vue ``` ### CDN Direct ```html ``` ## Key features ### Zero tracking, local-first SVGSpace uses IndexedDB browser caching. After your initial visit, the full catalog loads in under 10ms with zero telemetry or tracking. All preferences are stored locally. ### Multi-variant support Every icon can have up to 5 variants: - **Default**: Canonical full-color version - **Mono**: Single-color for unified UI grids - **Light**: Optimized for light backgrounds - **Dark**: Optimized for dark backgrounds - **Wordmark**: Text-based logo variant ### Bulk operations - **Favorites**: Build personal collections - **Batch export**: Download favorites as ZIP with all variants - **Category filtering**: Browse by 50+ organized categories - **Fuzzy search**: Find icons by name, alias, or category ### Developer experience - **Keyboard shortcuts**: `Cmd+K` to search, `/` to focus search - **Hot reloading**: Instant preview during development - **Error boundary**: Graceful fallbacks for missing assets - **SEO optimized**: Every icon page has full Open Graph and structured data ## Open source and free forever SVGSpace is published under the **Apache 2.0 license**: - Free for personal and commercial use - No API keys, no rate limits, no accounts required - Full source code available on GitHub - Community contributions welcome ## Get started **Browse the catalog**: https://svgspace.sbs **Submit an icon**: https://svgspace.sbs/?view=submit **GitHub repository**: https://github.com/Orildo-Tech/SVG-SPACE **NPM package**: `@orildo/icons` ## What's next We're actively working on: - **Figma plugin**: Insert icons directly into designs - **VS Code extension**: Search and insert icons while coding - **Enhanced submission tools**: Better validation and preview - **More collections**: Regional brands, design systems, vertical-specific icons - **API improvements**: Versioned endpoints and webhooks Join us in building the most comprehensive open SVG hosting platform. Every brand deserves a place in the open. --- SVGSpace is built by Orildo-Tech as part of our mission to create better developer tools. Follow us on GitHub for updates and contribute to make the platform even better.
